name: How do I know if my bathroom needs a full remodel or just an update?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my bathroom needs a full remodel or just an update?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the layout works and the core systems are in good shape, an update may be enough. If you have recurring leaks, damaged tile, failing plumbing, poor ventilation, or a layout that no longer fits your needs, a full remodel may be the better long-term choice. A contractor can inspect the hidden conditions before you decide.
acceptedAnswer.description: If the layout and systems are sound, an update may be enough. Recurring leaks, damage, or a bad layout usually point to a full remodel.
